svg.title: Dashboards
svg.desc: Animated. At the top, the robot publishes one value; a dot in a small gauge slides back and forth as the value changes. Dashed lines flow down from the robot to three dashboards, which all show that same value at the same moment, each its own way. Elastic, for the drive team in a match, shows one big, simple bar that grows and shrinks. AdvantageScope, for engineers, shows a graph scrolling past, live or from a log afterwards. This tool shows the value on a scale next to a green band for what it should be, and says in range or out of range.
svg.text: Dashboards: the same values, drawn different ways
Elastic, AdvantageScope and this tool are all NetworkTables clients.
They draw whatever topics the robot publishes: one value, three looks.
This tool also reads the robot's code and files on this laptop, so it says
not only what a number is but what it should be.
Shuffleboard, the older one, leaves WPILib in 2027.
